comment: The daily Cloudflare budget for this repository's CI (UTC day). The account is a friend's, on the free plan: all our tooling together must stay under 2,000 Worker requests a day. tools/cf-budget-check.mjs reads this file in the preview and deploy workflows, counts today's spin-ups and deploys through the GitHub API (read-only) and REFUSES to start the job when the budget is used up. Changing a number here is a decision for the account owner; the override label below is for the session that merges, nobody else.

jobs.spinUp: Spin Up Isolated PR Preview (Pages + Worker + D1 + DO)
jobs.deploy: Deploy Worker, D1 & Static Site to Cloudflare Production
